idea-plugin.name: Phantom Local Shared Index
idea-plugin.description: Reuses index data between checkouts of the same project on this machine, so a new worktree or clone does not index files that another checkout already indexed. Nothing leaves the machine. Turn it off by disabling the plugin.

registryKey.description: Phantom Local Shared Index: skip content-only indexes and stubs of files whose content another checkout indexed, answering from that file (prototype)
Phantom Local Shared Index: recompute every Nth cache hit and compare (0 = off)
